decision.reason: Demand and premium mix are both declining, and return rates at Oak & Ink and Corner Supply are elevated. Given the negative expected values across most modeled interventions, maintaining a no-outreach observation period is the most prudent approach to avoid further pressure on returns while market conditions stabilize. I considered the premium_alternative candidate but opted for observation due to the current demand softness.
